absorption-coeff-sabine.name: Sabine Absorption Coefficient Calculator
absorption-coeff-sabine.intro: Compute the average absorption coefficient from room volume, total surface area and reverberation time: ᾱ = 0.161·V / (S·RT60).

acoustic-impedance.name: Acoustic Impedance Calculator
acoustic-impedance.intro: Find the characteristic acoustic impedance of a medium from its density and sound speed: Z = ρ · c.

beat-frequency.name: Beat Frequency Calculator
beat-frequency.intro: Compute the beat frequency produced by two close tones: f_beat = |f₁ − f₂|.

combine-two-spl.name: Combine Two Sound Pressure Levels
combine-two-spl.intro: Combine two sound pressure levels on an energy basis: L = 10·log₁₀(10^(L₁/10) + 10^(L₂/10)).

critical-distance.name: Critical Distance Calculator
critical-distance.intro: Estimate the reverberation radius from source directivity, room volume and reverberation time: r_c ≈ 0.141·√(Q·V / RT60).

decibel-power-ratio.name: Decibel Power Ratio Calculator
decibel-power-ratio.intro: Convert a power ratio to decibels: L = 10·log₁₀(P₂ / P₁).

decibel-power.name: Decibel to Power Converter
decibel-power.intro: Convert between decibels and a power ratio using L = 10·log₁₀(P₂ / P₁).

decibel-voltage-ratio.name: Decibel Voltage Ratio Calculator
decibel-voltage-ratio.intro: Convert a voltage (amplitude) ratio to decibels: L = 20·log₁₀(V₂ / V₁).

decibel-voltage.name: Decibel to Voltage Converter
decibel-voltage.intro: Convert between decibels and a voltage or amplitude ratio using L = 20·log₁₀(V₂ / V₁).

doppler-acoustic.name: Acoustic Doppler Effect Calculator
doppler-acoustic.intro: Compute the observed frequency from source and receiver motion and the speed of sound.

freq-to-note.name: Frequency to Musical Note Converter
freq-to-note.intro: Convert a frequency to its MIDI note number: n = 69 + 12·log₂(f / 440).

intensity-inverse-square.name: Sound Intensity Inverse-Square Calculator
intensity-inverse-square.intro: Apply the inverse-square law to sound intensity with distance from a point source.

intensity-level.name: Sound Intensity Level Calculator
intensity-level.intro: Compute the intensity level from sound intensity relative to the reference I₀: L_I = 10·log₁₀(I / I₀).

mass-law-tl.name: Mass Law Transmission Loss Calculator
mass-law-tl.intro: Estimate the mass-law transmission loss of a partition: TL ≈ 20·log₁₀(f·m) − 48.

pipe-closed.name: Closed Pipe Fundamental Frequency Calculator
pipe-closed.intro: Compute the fundamental frequency of a closed (stopped) pipe from its length and the speed of sound.

pipe-open.name: Open Pipe Fundamental Frequency Calculator
pipe-open.intro: Compute the fundamental frequency of an open pipe from its length and the speed of sound.

reverberation-time.name: Reverberation Time (Sabine) Calculator
reverberation-time.intro: Compute Sabine reverberation time from room volume and total absorption: RT60 = 0.161·V / A.

room-axial-mode.name: Room Axial Mode Calculator
room-axial-mode.intro: Compute axial room modes from room dimension and mode order: f = n·c / (2L).

sound-intensity-level.name: Sound Intensity Level Calculator
sound-intensity-level.intro: Compute the sound intensity level from intensity relative to the reference I₀.

sound-intensity-spherical.name: Free-Field Sound Intensity Calculator
sound-intensity-spherical.intro: Compute free-field spherical sound intensity: I = P / (4πr²).

sound-power-level.name: Sound Power Level Calculator
sound-power-level.intro: Compute the sound power level from acoustic power: L_W = 10·log₁₀(W / W₀).

sound-pressure-level.name: Sound Pressure Level Calculator
sound-pressure-level.intro: Compute the sound pressure level from pressure relative to the reference p₀: SPL = 20·log₁₀(p / p₀).

sound-speed-air.name: Speed of Sound in Air Calculator
sound-speed-air.intro: Compute the speed of sound in air from the air temperature.

spl-add.name: Sound Pressure Level Addition Calculator
spl-add.intro: Add multiple sound pressure levels on a logarithmic (energy) basis.

spring-natural-freq.name: Spring-Mass Natural Frequency Calculator
spring-natural-freq.intro: Compute the natural frequency of a spring-mass system: f = (1 / 2π)·√(k / m).

string-fundamental.name: String Fundamental Frequency Calculator
string-fundamental.intro: Compute the fundamental frequency of a vibrating string from length, tension and linear density.

wavelength-frequency.name: Wavelength and Frequency Converter
wavelength-frequency.intro: Convert between wavelength and frequency for a given wave speed: λ = c / f.

wavelength-from-freq.name: Wavelength from Frequency Calculator
wavelength-from-freq.intro: Compute wavelength from frequency and wave speed: λ = c / f.
